scope: 111 frozen official WEBF pages fully read; operation identity reconciliation is checkpointed, not final. Existing photo/mobile/workflow fact index loaded for 4506 records; relevant named operations compared through 305 manually scoped rules.
method: Complete page full texts reviewed in frozen web_features.json; all source keys retained here.
Manual feature/operation scope rules, then exact labelled repeats inside the same reviewed family; no fuzzy/title similarity or automatic platform union.
Only groups relation SAME_OPERATION can be used as registry identity edges. relatedGroups never union keys.
Same function-purpose is not same operation: import/export/preview, control, condition and advertised outcome are distinguished.
Generic availability taglines, footer platform links, duplicated navigation and pricing descriptions do not prove native control availability.
No exact HTML source SHA-256 duplicate among 111 pages. Repeated boilerplate is information, not independent confirmation.

doNotMerge.reason: Non-prompt three-layer Background Fusion, prompt-generated background and two-layer Double Exposure are different operations.

Magic Eraser small-area workflow and Object Remover large-object workflow differ despite marketing synonym. Do not merge with Smart Removal solely by purpose.
Structural eyebrow Thickness/Position and Makeup style/amount are different operations; makeup position not documented.
User-selectable Standard/Enhanced differs from support automatic mode-selection condition.
Frown/Eleven Lines versus Forehead Wrinkles purpose cannot be merged from the same marketing title.
Lens Blur depth/bokeh controls and background blur controls are not globally interchangeable.
Global HSL channels, prompt/reference garment recolor and clothing-only mask color adjustment differ.
RGB 255-minus inversion is not B&W conversion.
Generative outpainting, ordinary gray/white/black canvas expansion, geometric resize and upscale are different.
Pet stray fur and human stray hair are different target operations. Pet fur function exists in support.
Web logo/signature watermark UI, Instant cloud watermark and Desktop export watermark are purpose-related; placement/tiling workflow and billing differ.
Free local-browser RAW conversion versus native edited AI export has different processing and credit events.
